counter_scope_source_evidence.scope: source inspection only; no model, no raw rewrite, no counter reclassification

findings.fact: cache_stats::print_stats filters m_stats by supplied CUDA streamID; framework cleanup passes finished kernel streamID. A last printed bucket is not automatically an all-stream total.
findings.consequence: Verify frozen population stream IDs. For multi-stream inputs, independently aggregate each stream latest complete cumulative bucket snapshot from closed raw or mark whole-input totals unavailable.

findings.fact: gpu-sim aggregates all L2 bank sub-stats before printing L2_total_cache_accesses/misses/reservation_fails, whereas named request-type breakdown is stream-filtered.
findings.consequence: Do not confuse global aggregate totals with GLOBAL_ACC_R per-stream breakdown. Counter shape and scope must accompany traffic claims.

findings.fact: print_fail_stats prints only positive values in a stream; missing reasons may reflect omission, scope or unavailable parsing.
findings.consequence: Existing missing reason counters remain unavailable, never silently zero-filled.

findings.fact: dram_t constructor initializes n_rd=0; DRAM read issuance increments it. n_rd is a command/atom count rather than request latency.
findings.consequence: Read traffic increase alone does not establish L2-to-DRAM queue latency increase.

findings.fact: memlatstat_print avg_mrq_latency is emitted conditionally from tot_mrq_latency/tot_mrq_num with integer division.
findings.consequence: Missing printed latency remains missing; audit reset/sampling semantics before claiming an application-weighted latency or summing means.

findings.fact: cache_stats breakdown prints per-status uint64 counts but TOTAL_ACCESS uses vector<unsigned> and %u.
findings.consequence: For very large counts check 32-bit overflow; prefer independently checked 64-bit sum of mutually exclusive accepted buckets. No actual overflow claim is made in this source-only note.

boundaries: rows.original is original scientific role; rows.selected is independent named view and is not substituted
